notes.title: Big News Soon... and a Store Page Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've updated the store page with new screenshots and GIFs of the various neighbors you'll meet while playing Danchi Days. Head on over to check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3107530/Danchi_Days/ 

In the meantime, keep an eye out for some big news from us. I wonder what it could be...?

notes.title: Thanks for 7,000 Wishlists! + News
notes.content:
Thank you for 7,000 wishlists on Danchi Days! We (Melos, mogumu and sandy) are so blessed to have the support of so many of you. We wanted to share some news updates with you.

First of all, we've decided to market ourselves as a "Summer Neighborvania Adventure." If you're interested in what this means, check out this video playthrough that Melos made.

[previewyoutube=_486t2TYVpI;full][/previewyoutube]

Second, over December we released a Streamer/Youtube-only demo to some great reception. Got any streamers you want us to send the demo to? Let us know in the comments!

Lastly, our plans for the upcoming year.

We'll be showing at Taipei Game Show next week for a few days - showing the newly localized Chinese demo. After that, there will be a few small shows in Japan, potentially Bitsummit in the summer.

For the most part though, we will be working on an extended, public demo that we'd like to release sometime in the middle of this year. Please look forward to it! 

- Melos
